summary: Operator growth tested config: OpenShift 4.14 with 1 control and 1 worker node, ansible-core 2.16+, PostgreSQL 15 managed or external 15-17 with ICU. The operator-deployed database allows 100 max_connections and 100 GB; don't use it with more than 1 replica of any component, over 100 concurrent jobs, over 100 total connections, or over 100 GB of 30-day storage.
questions: When should I not use the operator-deployed PostgreSQL database?
What are the limits of the AAP operator-deployed database?
Which OpenShift version was tested for the AAP growth topology?

answer_card.title: Operator-deployed database limits
answer_card.answer_md:
The operator-deployed PostgreSQL has `max_connections` 100 and a 100 GB maximum size.

Use an external database instead if any apply:
- More than 1 replica of gateway, controller, hub or EDA
- Controller capacity above 100 concurrent jobs
- Total database connections above 100
- Estimated 30-day database storage above 100 GB
